admission.justification: Recomputation, a silence-only value and absence were weighed with grounds, and the choice binds every future edit of the archive-ready branch.

alternatives.option: Bind kept_line = None on the archive branch: the gate is not judged again; the strict archive declares no kept-line record, so the repeat carries none and its answer may lack landedTips but invents none.
alternatives.reason: Ruling L129-THE-GATE-IS-NOT-JUDGED-AGAIN (a5ad3db2) under unchanged MIK-R129@v1; TerminalEnclosureArchive declares no judgement field and forbids extras; kept_line flows only to the optional landedTips attach; R2 fix-verification PASS with the 28-case suite including branch-gone completion.

alternatives.option: Recompute _carryover_or_kept_line on the archived contract for the repeat.
alternatives.reason: Re-judges the accepted gate on repeat and demands live refs the accepted first run may already have retired (sealed finding L129-CODE-R1-01, fixed); the R1-stage repair was superseded for exactly this.
alternatives.reconsider_when: The archive gains a kept-line judgement record, so a repeat can carry a recorded value instead of an absence.

alternatives.option: Bind an arbitrary value only to silence the type check.
alternatives.reason: The packet's nonconforming example: a value with no reason in the record.

consequences: The cleanup_result archive branch carries kept_line = None under a ruling-cited comment; dry repeats assert landedTips absent; real and branch-gone repeats run to cleanup-completed.
context: cleanup_result passed kept_line to the shared tail on every path but bound it only on the no-archive branch, so an archive-ready repeat — the only supported recovery from an interrupted cleanup — raised UnboundLocalError.
